summary: Riot Platforms filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing an October 7, 2026 BitGo Custodial Services Agreement, amended October 14, under which BitGo Bank Trust, National Association replaces NYDIG Trust Company LLC as custodian of Riot's digital assets and cash. Assets transfer under an account transition agreement; the NYDIG custodial agreement terminates automatically upon completion. Terms include segregated accounts, no commingling, monthly fee based on average assets under custody, commercially reasonable insurance, a one-year initial term with automatic one-year renewals and 60-day non-renewal notice, and 14-day early termination without penalty. This is a routine custody-vendor change, not a special situation; monitor counterparty and operational risk.
